mechanism: Both drugs increase dopaminergic activity through different mechanisms (risperidone as D2 antagonist used therapeutically; methylphenidate as catecholamine releaser), potentially creating paradoxical or additive CNS effects with increased cardiac stimulation.
action: Monitor cardiovascular parameters and psychotic symptoms closely; this combination is sometimes used intentionally in ADHD patients with comorbid psychosis but requires careful dose titration and clinical oversight.
